title: 第一卷 第4章 可平山海
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
打发走张大雷一行人，李华指着水桶，看向刘表：“还傻愣着干毛？”

    “拎桶。”

    “一点眼力见也没有。”

    刘表“哦”了一声，把桶拎起来，心里却是暗骂李华这是怎么了，一举一动都不像他了。

    李华摆摆手：“你们先走。”

    刘表还想说些什么，被阿青直接拽走。

    等俩人走远一些，李华看向张春妮：“别害怕，张大雷应该不会胡说八道。”

    “我那两个小弟你也不用担心，我会让他们管住嘴的。”

    张春妮低着头，“哦”了一声：“谢……谢谢。”

    李华笑：“别客气。”

    “这是我应该做的。”

    “走吧。”

    张春妮刚要跟上，却尴尬的发现，双脚陷的太深，无论她怎么使劲，都拔不出来。

    眼看着李华已经走出去几步，她赶紧呼喊：“等……等一下。”

    “我走不动。”

    “你……你能……能帮帮我吗？”

    李华走回去。

    “把手给我。”

    张春妮伸出双手。

    李华握住她的手腕，用力一拉，手滑没拽出来，他手上有淤泥，刚才用潮水没洗干净，滑滑腻腻的，根本吃不住劲。

    “你也抓我的手腕。”

    “哦，哦。”

    张春妮很听话。

    李华下意识抬头，两人目光对在一起，张春妮触电一样的躲开视线。

    都抓稳以后，李华再度使劲，结果用力过猛，整个人不由得往后一倒，他的脚也陷在淤泥里，来不及稳住身形，整个人仰面趴了下去。

    张春妮也跟着摔在了他身上。

    这一撞。

    让李华顿时僵住。

    来的时候背着，张春妮用手撑着他，其实感受并没有太强烈。

    但这次是直接撞上来的。

    把他给震撼到了。

    整张脸像是被山埋了，被压的无法呼吸。

    张春妮连忙撑起来，小声说道：“对不起，我……我不是故意的。”

    李华咳嗽两声，他想说妹子不用道歉，刚才缓冲挺大，没撞疼，反而挺舒服的，他嘴上则说道：“你没事吧？”

    张春妮点点头：“没……”

    “潮水过来了，还是和来的时候一样，我背着你出去，不然被潮水困住，就麻烦了。”

    “嗯……”
content_en:
After sending Zhang Dalei and his party away, Li Hua pointed at the bucket and looked at Liu Biao: "Are you still dumbfounded?"

    "Carry a bucket."

    "No vision at all."

    Liu Biao said "Oh" and picked up the bucket, but he secretly cursed Li Hua in his heart. What was wrong with him? He didn't look like him anymore.

    Li Hua waved his hand: "You go first."

    Liu Biao wanted to say something more, but Ah Qing dragged him away.

    When the two of them walked away, Li Hua looked at Zhang Chuni: "Don't be afraid, Zhang Dalei shouldn't talk nonsense."

    "Don't worry about my two younger brothers, I will tell them to keep their mouths shut."

    Zhang Chunni lowered her head and said "Oh": "Thank you... thank you."

    Li Hua smiled: "You're welcome."

    "This is what I should do."

    "Let's go."

    Zhang Chunni was about to follow, but found out to her embarrassment that her feet were stuck too deep, and no matter how hard she tried, she couldn't pull them out.

    Seeing that Li Hua had already taken a few steps out, she quickly shouted: "Wait...wait a minute."

    "I can't walk."

    "Can...can you...can you help me?"

    Li Hua walked back.

    "Give me your hand."

    Zhang Chunni stretched out her hands.

    Li Hua held her wrist and pulled hard, but the hand slipped and was not pulled out. There was mud on his hand, which had not been washed away with the tide just now. It was slippery and greasy, and he couldn't hold it anymore.

    "You grab my wrist too."

    "Oh, oh."

    Zhang Chunni is very obedient.

    Li Hua subconsciously raised his head, and the two of them looked at each other. Zhang Chunni looked away as if she had been electrocuted.

    After getting a firm grip, Li Hua tried again, but the force was too much, and he couldn't help but fall backwards. His feet got stuck in the mud, and he didn't have time to steady himself, so he fell down on his back.

    Zhang Chuni also fell on him.

    This collision.

    Li Hua suddenly froze.

    When he came, he was carried on his back and Zhang Chunni supported him with her hands. In fact, the feeling was not too strong.

    But this time it was a direct collision.

    It shocked him.

    The whole face seemed to be buried by the mountain, and it was so compressed that it was impossible to breathe.

    Zhang Chuni quickly stood up and whispered: "I'm sorry, I...I didn't mean it."

    Li Hua coughed twice. He wanted to say that the girl didn't need to apologize. The buffer was quite big just now. It didn't hurt, but it was quite comfortable. He said, "Are you okay?"

    Zhang Chuni nodded: "No..."

    "The tide is coming, and it's still the same as when it came. I'll carry you out, otherwise you'll be trapped by the tide and you'll be in trouble."

    "Well..."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 4 Can Level Mountains and Seas
